title: Check: Effect of Catalysts on Rate (2) (B)

questions.stem: What is the difference between a heterogeneous catalyst and a homogeneous catalyst?

options.text: Heterogeneous catalysts are used up; homogeneous catalysts are not
Heterogeneous catalysts change the products; homogeneous catalysts do not
Heterogeneous catalysts are faster; homogeneous catalysts are slower
Heterogeneous catalysts are in a different phase from the reactants; homogeneous catalysts are in the same phase

questions.explanation: A heterogeneous catalyst is in a different phase (state) from the reactants, such as a solid catalyst with liquid or gaseous reactants (e.g., iron in the Haber process). A homogeneous catalyst is in the same phase as the reactants, typically all dissolved in solution.
